tickets.summary: Kick off call - SOS Tech Group
tickets.description:
Hi Shaya, 

  

Thanks for your time and patience in today’s meeting. 

  

Let me summarize the points that we discussed in today’s call: 

  

1. Kindly review the prerequisites and technical aspects to ensure that preparations are made to avoid encountering any issues during the migration. 

2. On the next call we required the Dropbox(Team Admin Credentials)for the source and destination SharePoint (Global Admin credentials) are required for cloud adding. 

3. Attaching the Kick-off Deck. Kindly review. 

4. For the upcoming call, please ensure the CSV for the migration is prepared and the SharePoint sites need to create prior of the migration. 

6. Please confirm do we need to select all versions for the migration. 

7. Versions will take good time for completion. 

8. Rate limit issue can slow down the performance. 

9. Versions and Metadata will double the data size on the destination. 

  

 *Note* : During the one-time migration, users should not use the destination migrated folders and In the Delta Migration Process, it is recommended that users refrain from utilizing both the source and destination until the entire migration process is completed. 

  

Please let me know if you have any questions. 

  

Thanks, 
|
